_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 6: How To Create A Skill (CP2, shown FIRST: v6 -> build step -> v5). 6 diagrams in teaching order, one column each, left to right. Rebuilt 2026-09-23 on the running example draft-email/ (DESIGN-SYSTEM section 9): the skill that writes this week's email; gold standard = best-email.md, the best weekly email you've sent. Through-line (Rashid, 2026-07-26): a good skill starts with CLARITY ABOUT HOW YOU ALREADY WORK, not with prompting. 02 and 03 line up 1:1 (five questions = five things you give) and 06 reuses 02's exact file view.
hard_rule: NO SUBFOLDER NAMES IN THIS DECK. Do not reintroduce workflows/, references/, scripts/ or assets/ as destinations here. Rashid, 2026-07-26: 'I don't want people to be confused with workflows assets and references — I just want them to know what to give.' The gold standard is shown as the file best-email.md, never as assets/best-email.md. The folder anatomy is taught once, in v1-what-is-a-skill, and is not repeated here.
the_five_inputs: The steps, in the order you do them
the_five_inputs_rule: ONE label set, used verbatim as the v6-02 and v6-06 file headings and the v6-03 row labels. The interview questions on v6-02 map onto them in this order: 'What do you do first, then next?' / 'What method do you follow?' / 'Show me your best one so far.' / 'What files do you work from?' / 'When do you NOT do it this way?'

columns.label: 1 - CLARITY FIRST: same AI, only what you told it changed
2 - IT INTERVIEWS YOU: five questions, each answer becomes a section
3 - THE FIVE THINGS YOU GIVE IT (and how much detail)
4 - ONE REAL EXAMPLE BEATS ADJECTIVES (your gold standard)
5 - WHERE THE JOB CHANGES: one job, several versions
6 - IT ALL LIVES IN ONE FILE: you say it once, it keeps it
